name: PAL GROUP Holdings CO., LTD.
summary: PAL GROUP Holdings CO., LTD. engages in the sale of clothing in Japan. The company operates in two segments, Apparel Business and General Merchandise Business. It engages in the manufacturing and sale of clothing and other apparel; and the retail of daily necessities and other goods. The company was formerly known as Pal Co., Ltd. and changed its name to PAL GROUP Holdings CO., LTD. in September 2016. PAL GROUP Holdings CO., LTD. was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
